topics.name: Artificial Intelligence (AI)
topics.summary: AI dominates the news cycle, covering advancements in autonomous agents, economic policy for AGI, consumer applications like design tools and music plugins, infrastructure development for AI chips and data centers, and critical discussions around safety, regulation, job displacement, and privacy concerns related to AI systems.

topics.name: Consumer Technology & Gadgets
topics.summary: This category highlights new product launches and deals, including smart earbuds, retro digital cameras, refurbished tech savings, streaming device updates, gaming news, and smart home appliances, reflecting ongoing innovation and market adjustments in consumer electronics.

topics.name: Developer & Infrastructure
topics.summary: News in this area covers core software development, including operating systems, programming frameworks, security incidents like source code leaks, changes to platform policies (e.g., GitLab rate limits), and significant infrastructure updates from major cloud providers, alongside historical perspectives on software philosophy.

topics.name: Space & Science
topics.summary: Features updates from NASA on space exploration, celestial phenomena, Earth sciences, and aeronautical research, alongside scientific breakthroughs in areas like neuroscience (human brain cells in mice), archaeology (ancient scrolls), and physics (neutrinos).

topics.name: Tech Policy & Society
topics.summary: Focuses on regulatory changes impacting technology, such as Apple's app tracking transparency in the EU and debates over net neutrality, as well as broader societal implications like free speech rights in digital communications.
